concept.title: Air-gapped or disconnected deployments
concept.shortdesc: Red Hat Quay supports air-gapped and disconnected deployments with internet-connected registries and firewall access, or fully disconnected installations with offline media transfer. You can choose the pattern that matches your network constraints.

conbody.p: In the following diagram, the upper deployment in the diagram shows Red Hat Quay and Clair connected to the internet, with an air-gapped OpenShift Container Platform cluster accessing the Red Hat Quay registry through an explicit, allowlisted hole in the firewall.

The lower deployment in the diagram shows Red Hat Quay and Clair running inside of the firewall, with image and CVE data transferred to the target system using offline media. The data is exported from a separate Red Hat Quay and Clair deployment that is connected to the internet.

image.alt: Red Hat Quay and Clair in disconnected or air-gapped environments
